definitions.burned_cum_raw: Every STANDARD token ever sent to the burn address (0x0), including deposit conversions that are re-mintable later. Not all of this is permanent -- see burned_forever_cum_raw.
definitions.burned_forever_cum_raw: STANDARD burned through the public burn/burnFrom path (buybacks, POL fee disposal, voluntary burns). Permanently lowers max_supply_raw and can never be re-minted.
definitions.burned_sbill_exit_cum_raw: STANDARD burned as the burned half of S-Bill early-exit fees (Transfer from the S-Bills contract to 0x0). A measured subset of burned_cum_raw and burned_forever_cum_raw.
definitions.circulating_excluding_sbills_raw: circulating_raw minus the STANDARD held by the S-Bills contract (staked principal plus unpaid premium budget). A derived float figure; circulating_raw itself is unchanged.
definitions.deposited_cum_raw: STANDARD burned by depositing it into the CentralBank ledger (convertFrom). Counted in burned_cum_raw but NOT in burned_forever_cum_raw or max_supply_raw -- the value becomes ledger credit that a later withdrawal re-mints.
definitions.ledger_retired_cum_raw: Unminted CentralBank ledger value written off with no token ever moving (license payments, the non-recycled half of resolution/revocation fees). Lowers max_supply_raw the same way a permanent burn does, but is not part of burned_cum_raw since no Transfer occurs.

items.description: Explain and preflight an unsigned Base transaction, EIP-712 typed data, or an EIP-3009 x402 payment authorization before you sign it. Decodes intent against verified ABIs, resolves proxies, classifies approvals, and checks a payment authorization against the quote it claims to pay: recipient, amount, asset, chain, freshness, and nonce replay. Returns unknown rather than guessing when a selector is ambiguous. Not a guarantee that a transaction is safe or profitable.

No Base RPC endpoint is configured, so chain-dependent fields are unknown rather than assumed. See result.unresolved.

authorization.description: An EIP-3009 authorization, which is what an x402 `exact` payment is. value in base units, validAfter/validBefore in unix seconds, nonce 32 random bytes not a counter.

expected_quote.description: The x402 quote this payment claims to satisfy. Enables the comparison checks.

simulate.description: Run eth_simulateV1 with asset tracing. Priced at $0.03 instead of $0.02, and targets P50 2s / P95 5s rather than the static path's 500ms / 2s.

typed_data.description: EIP-712 payload. TransferWithAuthorization and ReceiveWithAuthorization get the x402 check table; any other primaryType is reported unrecognised, not analysed.

items.description: Decide whether an agent-authored PostgreSQL statement complies with an execution policy, using PostgreSQL's own parser rather than pattern matching. Detects statement stacking, data-modifying CTEs, COPY PROGRAM, privilege changes, and dangerous functions that read as ordinary SELECTs. Returns reason codes and an optional short-lived signed permit bound to the exact normalized statement. Never connects to your database.

body.sql: SELECT id, total FROM analytics.orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

result.normalized_sql: SELECT id, total FROM analytics.orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

warnings: stmt_fingerprint is ADVISORY and must not be used for authorization: libpg-query fingerprints discard literal constants, so two statements differing only in a value share one fingerprint. stmt_hash is the binding value.

audience.description: Identity of the ONE executor the permit is for. Required when issue_permit is true. Wildcards are rejected.

allow_multi_statement.description: Permit more than one statement in the input. Defaults to false.

allow_returning.description: Accept RETURNING on a permitted write without a warning.

allow_row_locks.description: Accept SELECT ... FOR UPDATE without a warning.

allowed_functions.description: Added to the built-in allowlist. Bare name, or schema.function to admit one of your own.

allowed_languages.description: Permitted CREATE FUNCTION languages. Defaults to none.

allowed_tables.description: Permitted relations as schema.table, or a bare name to match an unqualified reference.

max_rows.description: Row ceiling. Becomes a permit obligation the executor enforces.

read_only.description: Reject anything that can change data or schema, including writes reached through a CTE.

statement_timeout_ms.description: Timeout written into the permit obligations. Defaults to 30000.

subject.description: Opaque caller label recorded as the permit subject.

target_pg_major.description: Required. The PostgreSQL major the statement will run on. Only 18 is supported in v1: a permit issued under one grammar and verified against another is a parser differential.

normalized_sql.description: Deparsed canonical statement. This, not your original text, is what a permit binds.

permit.description: Compact JWS. Present only when requested and the verdict is not block.

stmt_fingerprint.description: ADVISORY ONLY — never authorize on this. libpg-query fingerprints discard literal constants, so 'WHERE id = 1' and 'WHERE id = 999999' share one fingerprint.

stmt_hash.description: BINDING. sha256 of normalized_sql. The executor recomputes this from the statement it is about to run.
